cases_per_layout: at least2 each; draw legacy count uniformly from2..N-2, PP receives remainder

dose.formula: one uniform target per case; ratio = target * healthy median whole-step ms / healthy selected-compute estimate per step
dose.source: existing healthy calibration/catalog only; preserve estimation uncertainty and actual FMA attestation
dose.zero_estimate: retain as preflight-invalid; do not redraw site or seed

execution.source: submitted commit plus actual deployed source hashes; no change after draw

predictions: seal public events/hash for both sessions before any truth scoring

randomization.L3: FWD only; uniform eligible family then eligible component site from frozen healthy catalog
randomization.L4: FWD framed-ATen only; uniform eligible operator family then eligible site from frozen healthy catalog
randomization.assignment: draw N, layout counts and tier allocation once from frozen seed; N5/6 not forced equal split
randomization.population: all currently supported eligible healthy-catalog sites; freeze population and hashes before draw; never select by old pass/fail
randomization.rank: uniform integer0..15 independently per case, then uniformly choose eligible supported site for that rank; freeze eligibility audit before draw
randomization.when: only after root supplies submitted commit; draw one seed once, persist before selection

report.cost: cite final same-source measured budgets; fault wall is not PROFILE overhead

schedule.first_fault_start: Uniform integer43..58 (>=30 real monitored healthy steps after warmup)
schedule.subsequent_fault_start: previous fault end +31+Uniform integer0..15 (>=30 complete healthy recovery steps)

tiers: each of L1/L2/L3/L4 at least1; remaining N-4 tiers drawn uniformly then all tiers shuffled across layout slots

unknown_detection_contract.current_source_audit: online.py/online_v2.py do not read plan.json; node_collection controller argv has no --plan; no production modification required
unknown_detection_contract.detector: normal production BEAST MONITOR -> automatically requested PROFILE -> localization; continuation remains core-only
unknown_detection_contract.future_public_view: if future source reads full plan, stop source-binding preflight and report before modifying production; never silently introduce a modified controller
unknown_detection_contract.truth_access: fault schedule/labels only injector and post-seal scorer; controller consumes configuration/topology/models/observed evidence, not plan or truth logs
